pages.quiz:
MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x > 5

2. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 8
   D. 24.5

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

5. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 30
   C. 45
   D. 36

9. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

10. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
